news.title: “After All These Years, We’re Going Home” – The Forever Journey Ep. 1
news.description: Blizzard just released episode 1 of the WoW Forever Journey miniseries, and it's heart wrenchingly beautiful.

news.title: Raid-Wide Buffs, Auras, and Totems Coming in WoW Forever
news.description: In WoW Forever, certain buffs, totems, and auras will now be raid-wide, allowing for more flexibility in your raid comp!

news.title: WoW Forever Is Hiding Instance Portals Nobody Can Enter Yet
news.description: Portals that lead nowhere, a raid entrance inside a dungeon and Gilneas guarded by elites. The WoW Podcast hints at the future of WoW Forever.

news.title: Blizzard Just Gave WoW Forever Testers a Stats Page With Odd Surprises
news.description: The WoW Forever beta ended today. Blizzard’s Timewalking site shows your quests, bug reports, and a few stats funnier than you’d expect.

news.title: Name Reservation, Raids, Campfire, and More in Forever, Hallow’s End in Retail, New Patch in Classic: WoW Weekly, October 19 – 23
news.description: We have a ton of feature previews for Forever, a holiday event in retail, and a brand new patch in Classic in this week's official post summary!

news.title: The WoW Forever Beta Has Ended, a Thank You From Blizzard
news.description: A big thank you from Blizzard arrives at the end of the Forever Beta, with some additional info on top, so let's take a look!

news.title: The WoW Forever Podcast Will Continue After Beta
news.description: Blizzard has hinted that the WoW Forever podcast will continue to produce episodes even after the beta ends!

news.title: The WoW Forever Beta Is Going Out With Murlocs Dropping Molten Core Loot
news.description: WoW Forever’s end of beta event is live. Mobs of every level drop the Molten Core loot table and stat elixirs, and world bosses are roaming.
